_what: A handle minted on 2026-10-29 by the credentials-vault crate as it was before its product identity became caller-supplied (its handle MAC key context was then hardcoded inside the crate). Minted with the unmodified crate at trillion/crates/credentials-vault from the fixed KEK below. tests/credentials_vault_identity.rs proves the current crate, given Trillion's identity word, still derives the same handle key and verifies this token byte for byte. Never regenerate: its value is that it predates the change. `word` is the identity word it was minted under, the one Trillion's launcher hands the engine.
